condition: rolling_corr/rolling_cov use mean(xy)-mean(x)mean(y), causing catastrophic cancellation and wildly wrong results on data with large magnitude relative to its variance (e.g. prices).
workaround: Subtract a constant (e.g. the column mean or first value) from the inputs before calling rolling_cov/rolling_corr; covariance and correlation don't change when a constant is subtracted.
